ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with localized high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and streaking concentrated on the lateral-distal regions of the right lobe; sparse linear white streaks on the left lobe; high-contrast white clusters localized at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by frequent, low-amplitude serrations and several distinct, deeper indentations distributed along the entire length of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the outer margins leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear marks distributed across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and concentrated barnacle colonization at the distal tips.
